**Klynge SYD** is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It serves as a fundamental organizational unit for monitoring, benchmarking, and improving the clinical quality of care for patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src3] [^src5]. As part of the national quality assurance framework managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut, Klynge SYD's performance is systematically evaluated across a wide range of healthcare quality indicators [^src1] [^src8].

The cluster is frequently noted for meeting national clinical standards. For example, in the 2024 "Atrieflimren i Danmark" report, Klynge SYD was highlighted as one of the healthcare clusters that successfully fulfilled the standard for Indikator 1, achieving a 92.9% (95% CI: 89.0–95.7) result for the timely initiation of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation therapy) among newly diagnosed patients [^src1]. Historical data also shows strong performance; between July 1, 2018, and June 30, 2019, the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients receiving anticoagulation treatment in Klynge SYD was 94.3% (95% CI: 88.5–97.7) [^src3]. 

Beyond initial treatment, Klynge SYD is tracked for long-term treatment coverage, severe bleeding incidents, heart failure development, and mortality [^src2] [^src6] [^src7]. Geographic analyses of [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], which measures the incidence of ischemic stroke, place Klynge SYD among the monitored clusters, contributing to national maps that visualize regional variations in patient outcomes [^src4]. The continuous publication of these metrics in the 2024 and 2025 annual reports enables local and regional health authorities to identify strengths and weaknesses in clinical practice, ensuring that Klynge SYD remains integrated into Denmark's hierarchical strategy for cardiovascular quality improvement alongside other units like [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] and [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] [^src9] [^src11].
